title: Alien autopsy document and the other Edgar Mitchell papers

tellings.quote: And then he sent me the alien autopsy document and that had Kit Green

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron says that in the 2000s he was sent a set of papers connected to Edgar Mitchell, the Apollo astronaut, including a document about an alien autopsy that mentioned a man named Kit Green. He says the papers, which he links to a man named James Rigney, also included a condolence letter tied to the aviator Charles Lindbergh and a record of meetings of NIDS, a private group that studied strange phenomena. If genuine, the papers would suggest that well-known figures were quietly handling material about non-human bodies.
